quotes.text: A cloud flow is the polite guest who walks in through the front door and uses the intercom. A desktop flow is the worker who climbs in the way a person does through the screen.

quotes.text: Pick one task you do every day. Something that takes five minutes and never changes, and automate that.

quotes.text: Remember this one thing because this tool automates the screen and screens change. So expect to maintain your flows, not just build them once.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarises the core maintenance reality of UI-based automation.

takeaways: Power Automate Desktop is free low-code RPA that automates apps without an API by driving the screen like a person.
Cloud flows handle triggers and connected apps, while desktop flows do the clicking, and a cloud flow can start a desktop flow and pass variables both ways.
Attended runs are free on your own PC, but unattended runs need a paid license, a free machine and tolerant selectors that you keep maintaining.
hook: Many people repeat the same clicks every day in old apps that cannot connect to anything. This episode explains Power Automate Desktop for beginners and business users, from the recorder to attended and unattended runs. You will learn how it works, where it breaks and what it really costs.
